A000027.name: The positive integers. Also called the natural numbers, the whole numbers or the counting numbers, but these terms are ambiguous.

A000037.name: Numbers that are not squares (or, the nonsquares).

A000069.name: Odious numbers: numbers with an odd number of 1's in their binary expansion.

A000124.name: Central polygonal numbers (the Lazy Caterer's sequence): n(n+1)/2 + 1; or, maximal number of pieces formed when slicing a pancake with n cuts.

A000125.name: Cake numbers: maximal number of pieces resulting from n planar cuts through a cube (or cake): C(n+1,3) + n + 1.

A000201.name: Lower Wythoff sequence (a Beatty sequence): a(n) = floor(n*phi), where phi = (1+sqrt(5))/2 = A001622.

A000217.name: Triangular numbers: a(n) = binomial(n+1,2) = n*(n+1)/2 = 0 + 1 + 2 + ... + n.

A000292.name: Tetrahedral (or triangular pyramidal) numbers: a(n) = C(n+2,3) = n*(n+1)*(n+2)/6.

A000330.name: Square pyramidal numbers: a(n) = 0^2 + 1^2 + 2^2 + ... + n^2 = n*(n+1)*(2*n+1)/6.

A000378.name: Sums of three squares: numbers of the form x^2 + y^2 + z^2.

A000379.name: Numbers where total number of 1-bits in the exponents of their prime factorization is even; a 2-way classification of integers: complement of A000028.

A000404.name: Numbers that are the sum of 2 nonzero squares.

A000408.name: Numbers that are the sum of three nonzero squares.

A000419.name: Numbers that are the sum of 3 but no fewer nonzero squares.

A000567.name: Octagonal numbers: n*(3*n-2). Also called star numbers.

A000695.name: Moser-de Bruijn sequence: sums of distinct powers of 4.

A000788.name: Total number of 1's in binary expansions of 0, ..., n.

A000960.name: Flavius Josephus's sieve: Start with the natural numbers; at the k-th sieving step, remove every (k+1)-st term of the sequence remaining after the (k-1)-st sieving step; iterate.

A000961.name: Powers of primes. Alternatively, 1 and the prime powers (p^k, p prime, k >= 1).

A000977.name: Numbers that are divisible by at least three different primes.

A001043.name: Numbers that are the sum of 2 successive primes.

A001106.name: 9-gonal (or enneagonal or nonagonal) numbers: a(n) = n*(7*n-5)/2.

A001358.name: Semiprimes (or biprimes): products of two primes.

A001481.name: Numbers that are the sum of 2 squares.

A001597.name: Perfect powers: m^k where m > 0 and k >= 2.

A001633.name: Numbers with an odd number of digits.

A001637.name: Numbers with an even number of digits.

A001694.name: Powerful numbers, definition (1): if a prime p divides n then p^2 must also divide n (also called squareful, square full, square-full or 2-powerful numbers).

A001844.name: Centered square numbers: a(n) = 2*n*(n+1)+1. Sums of two consecutive squares. Also, consider all Pythagorean triples (X, Y, Z=Y+1) ordered by increasing Z; then sequence gives Z values.

A001845.name: Centered octahedral numbers (crystal ball sequence for cubic lattice).

A001855.name: Sorting numbers: maximal number of comparisons for sorting n elements by binary insertion.

A001913.name: Full reptend primes: primes with primitive root 10.

A001950.name: Upper Wythoff sequence (a Beatty sequence): a(n) = floor(n*phi^2), where phi = (1+sqrt(5))/2.

A001952.name: A Beatty sequence: a(n) = floor(n*(2 + sqrt(2))).

A001954.name: a(n) = floor((n+1/2)*(2+sqrt(2))); winning positions in the 2-Wythoff game.

A001969.name: Evil numbers: nonnegative integers with an even number of 1's in their binary expansion.

A002061.name: Central polygonal numbers: a(n) = n^2 - n + 1.

A002088.name: Sum of totient function: a(n) = Sum_{k=1..n} phi(k), cf. A000010.

A002144.name: Pythagorean primes: primes of the form 4*k + 1.

A002202.name: Values taken by totient function phi(m) (A000010).

A002378.name: Oblong (or promic, pronic, or heteromecic) numbers: a(n) = n*(n+1).

A002412.name: Hexagonal pyramidal numbers, or greengrocer's numbers.

A002620.name: Quarter-squares: a(n) = floor(n/2)*ceiling(n/2). Equivalently, a(n) = floor(n^2/4).

A002808.name: The composite numbers: numbers n of the form x*y for x > 1 and y > 1.

A002822.name: Numbers m such that 6m-1, 6m+1 are twin primes.

A002858.name: Ulam numbers: a(1) = 1; a(2) = 2; for n>2, a(n) = least number > a(n-1) which is a unique sum of two distinct earlier terms.

A002859.name: a(1) = 1, a(2) = 3; for n >= 3, a(n) is smallest number that is uniquely of the form a(j) + a(k) with 1 <= j < k < n.

A002977.name: Klarner-Rado sequence: a(1) = 1; subsequent terms are defined by the rule that if m is present so are 2m+1 and 3m+1.

A003052.name: Self numbers or Colombian numbers (numbers that are not of the form m + sum of digits of m for any m).

A003136.name: Loeschian numbers: numbers of the form x^2 + xy + y^2; norms of vectors in A2 lattice.

A003154.name: Centered 12-gonal numbers, or centered dodecagonal numbers: numbers of the form 6*k*(k-1) + 1.

A003159.name: Numbers whose binary representation ends in an even number of zeros.

A003215.name: Hex (or centered hexagonal) numbers: 3*n*(n+1)+1 (crystal ball sequence for hexagonal lattice).

A003277.name: Cyclic numbers: k such that k and phi(k) are relatively prime; also k such that there is just one group of order k, i.e., A000001(k) = 1.

A003309.name: Ludic numbers: apply the same sieve as Eratosthenes, but cross off every k-th remaining number.

A003325.name: Numbers that are the sum of 2 positive cubes.

A003601.name: Numbers j such that the average of the divisors of j is an integer: sigma_0(j) divides sigma_1(j). Alternatively, numbers j such that tau(j) (A000005(j)) divides sigma(j) (A000203(j)).

A003622.name: The Wythoff compound sequence AA: a(n) = floor(n*phi^2) - 1, where phi = (1+sqrt(5))/2.

A003629.name: Primes p == +- 3 (mod 8), or, primes p such that 2 is not a square mod p.

A003714.name: Fibbinary numbers: if n = F(i1) + F(i2) + ... + F(ik) is the Zeckendorf representation of n (i.e., write n in Fibonacci number system) then a(n) = 2^(i1 - 2) + 2^(i2 - 2) + ... + 2^(ik - 2). Also numbers whose binary representation contains no two adjacent 1's.

A003754.name: Numbers with no adjacent 0's in binary expansion.

A004202.name: Skip 1, take 1, skip 2, take 2, skip 3, take 3, etc.

A004207.name: a(0) = 1, a(n) = sum of digits of all previous terms.

A004215.name: Numbers that are the sum of 4 but no fewer nonzero squares.

A004431.name: Numbers that are the sum of 2 distinct nonzero squares.

A004709.name: Cubefree numbers: numbers that are not divisible by any cube > 1.

A004919.name: a(n) = floor(n*phi^4), where phi is the golden ratio, A001622.

A004920.name: a(n) = floor(n*phi^5), where phi is the golden ratio, A001622.

A004921.name: a(n) = floor(n*phi^6), phi = golden ratio, A001622.

A004922.name: a(n) = floor(n*phi^7), where phi is the golden ratio, A001622.

A005098.name: Numbers k such that 4k + 1 is prime.

A005100.name: Deficient numbers: numbers k such that sigma(k) < 2k.

A005101.name: Abundant numbers (sum of divisors of m exceeds 2m).

A005117.name: Squarefree numbers: numbers that are not divisible by a square greater than 1.

A005122.name: Numbers k such that 8k - 1 is prime.

A005123.name: Numbers k such that 8k + 1 is prime.

A005124.name: Numbers k such that 8k + 3 is prime.

A005125.name: Numbers k such that 8k - 3 is prime.

A005153.name: Practical numbers: positive integers m such that every k <= sigma(m) is a sum of distinct divisors of m. Also called panarithmic numbers.

A005187.name: a(n) = a(floor(n/2)) + n; also denominators in expansion of 1/sqrt(1-x) are 2^a(n); also 2n - number of 1's in binary expansion of 2n.

A005228.name: Sequence and first differences (A030124) together list all positive numbers exactly once.

A005236.name: Barriers for omega(n): numbers n such that, for all m < n, m + omega(m) <= n.

A005237.name: Numbers k such that k and k+1 have the same number of divisors.

A005277.name: Nontotients: even numbers k such that phi(m) = k has no solution.

A005349.name: Niven (or Harshad, or harshad) numbers: numbers that are divisible by the sum of their digits.

A005382.name: Primes p such that 2p-1 is also prime.

A005383.name: Primes p such that (p+1)/2 is prime.

A005384.name: Sophie Germain primes p: 2p+1 is also prime.

A005385.name: Safe primes p: (p-1)/2 is also prime.

A005574.name: Numbers k such that k^2 + 1 is prime.

A005836.name: Numbers whose base-3 representation contains no 2.

A005891.name: Centered pentagonal numbers: (5n^2+5n+2)/2; crystal ball sequence for 3.3.3.4.4. planar net.

A005902.name: Centered icosahedral (or cuboctahedral) numbers, also crystal ball sequence for f.c.c. lattice.

A006046.name: Total number of odd entries in first n rows of Pascal's triangle: a(0) = 0, a(1) = 1, a(2k) = 3*a(k), a(2k+1) = 2*a(k) + a(k+1).  a(n) = Sum_{i=0..n-1} 2^wt(i).

A006049.name: Numbers k such that k and k+1 have the same number of distinct prime divisors.

A006218.name: a(n) = Sum_{k=1..n} floor(n/k); also Sum_{k=1..n} d(k), where d = number of divisors (A000005); also number of solutions to x*y = z with 1 <= x,y,z <= n.

A006254.name: Numbers k such that 2k-1 is prime.

A006446.name: Numbers k such that floor(sqrt(k)) divides k.

A006450.name: Prime-indexed primes: primes with prime subscripts.

A006562.name: Balanced primes (of order one): primes which are the average of the previous prime and the following prime.

A006567.name: Emirps (primes whose reversal is a different prime).

A006753.name: Smith (or joke) numbers: composite numbers k such that sum of digits of k = sum of digits of prime factors of k (counted with multiplicity).

A006881.name: Squarefree semiprimes: Numbers that are the product of two distinct primes.

A006995.name: Binary palindromes: numbers whose binary expansion is palindromic.

A007088.name: The binary numbers (or binary words, or binary vectors, or binary expansion of n): numbers written in base 2.

A007304.name: Sphenic numbers: products of 3 distinct primes.

A007412.name: The noncubes: a(n) = n + floor((n + floor(n^(1/3)))^(1/3)).

A007494.name: Numbers that are congruent to 0 or 2 mod 3.

A007504.name: Sum of the first n primes.

A007510.name: Single (or isolated or non-twin) primes: Primes p such that neither p-2 nor p+2 is prime.

A007519.name: Primes of form 8n+1, that is, primes congruent to 1 mod 8.

A007522.name: Primes of the form 8*k+7, that is, primes congruent to -1 mod 8.

A007529.name: Prime triples: p; p+2 or p+4; p+6 all prime.

A007591.name: Numbers k such that k^2 + 4 is prime.

A007617.name: Values not in range of Euler phi function.

A007674.name: Numbers m such that m and m+1 are squarefree.

A007675.name: Numbers m such that m, m+1 and m+2 are squarefree.

A007693.name: Primes p such that 6*p + 1 is also prime.

A007770.name: Happy numbers: numbers whose trajectory under iteration of sum of squares of digits map (see A003132) includes 1.

A007774.name: Numbers that are divisible by exactly 2 different primes; numbers n with omega(n) = A001221(n) = 2.

A007821.name: Primes p such that pi(p) is not prime.

A007916.name: Numbers that are not perfect powers.

A007950.name: Binary sieve: delete every 2nd number, then every 4th, 8th, etc.

A007951.name: Ternary sieve: delete every 3rd number, then every 9th, 27th, etc.

A008365.name: 13-rough numbers: positive integers that have no prime factors less than 13.

A008854.name: Numbers that are congruent to {0, 1, 4} mod 5.

A009994.name: Numbers with digits in nondecreasing order.

A009996.name: Numbers with digits in nonincreasing order.

A010061.name: Binary self or Colombian numbers: numbers that cannot be expressed as the sum of distinct terms of the form 2^k+1 (k>=0), or equivalently, numbers not of form m + sum of binary digits of m.

A011531.name: Numbers that contain a digit 1 in their decimal representation.

A011537.name: Numbers that contain at least one 7.

A011539.name: "9ish numbers": decimal representation contains at least one nine.

A013929.name: Numbers that are not squarefree. Numbers that are divisible by a square greater than 1. The complement of A005117.

A013939.name: Partial sums of sequence A001221 (number of distinct primes dividing n).

A014091.name: Numbers that are the sum of 2 primes.

A014092.name: Numbers that are not the sum of 2 primes.

A014132.name: Complement of triangular numbers (A000217); also array T(n,k) = ((n+k)^2 + n-k)/2, n, k > 0, read by antidiagonals.

A014261.name: Numbers that contain odd digits only.

A014263.name: Numbers that contain even digits only.

A014312.name: Numbers with exactly 4 ones in binary expansion.

A014313.name: Numbers with exactly 5 ones in binary expansion.

A014612.name: Numbers that are the product of exactly three (not necessarily distinct) primes.

A014613.name: Numbers that are products of 4 primes.

A014614.name: Numbers that are products of 5 primes (or 5-almost primes, a generalization of semiprimes).

A016105.name: Blum integers: numbers of the form p * q where p and q are distinct primes congruent to 3 (mod 4).

A016754.name: Odd squares: a(n) = (2n+1)^2. Also centered octagonal numbers.

A019506.name: Hoax numbers: composite numbers whose digit-sum equals the sum of the digit-sums of its distinct prime factors.

A020756.name: Numbers that are the sum of two triangular numbers.

A020757.name: Numbers that are not the sum of two triangular numbers.

A020893.name: Squarefree sums of two squares; or squarefree numbers with no prime factors of the form 4k+3.

A020899.name: Numbers k with an odd number of terms in their Zeckendorf representation (write k as a sum of non-consecutive distinct Fibonacci numbers).

A022004.name: Initial members of prime triples (p, p+2, p+6).

A022005.name: Initial members of prime triples (p, p+4, p+6).

A022155.name: Values of n at which Golay-Rudin-Shapiro sequence A020985 is negative.

A022342.name: Integers with "even" Zeckendorf expansions (do not end with ... + F_2 = ... + 1) (the Fibonacci-even numbers); also, apart from first term, a(n) = Fibonacci successor to n-1.

A022544.name: Numbers that are not the sum of 2 squares.

A022559.name: Sum of exponents in prime-power factorization of n!.

A022838.name: Beatty sequence for sqrt(3); complement of A054406.

A022843.name: Beatty sequence for e: a(n) = floor(n*e).

A022848.name: Integer nearest nx, where x = sqrt(5).

A023200.name: Primes p such that p + 4 is also prime.

A023201.name: Primes p such that p + 6 is also prime. (Lesser of a pair of sexy primes.)

A023202.name: Primes p such that p + 8 is also prime.

A023203.name: Primes p such that p + 10 is also prime.

A023204.name: Primes p such that 2*p + 3 is also prime.

A023208.name: Primes p such that 3*p + 2 is also prime.

A023209.name: Primes p such that 3p + 4 is also prime.

A023210.name: Primes p such that 3*p + 8 is also prime.

A023211.name: Primes p such that 3*p + 10 is also prime.

A023212.name: Primes p such that 4*p+1 is also prime.

A023213.name: Primes p such that 4p + 3 is prime.

A023214.name: Primes p such that 4*p + 5 is also prime.

A023215.name: Primes p such that 4*p + 7 is also prime.

A023216.name: Primes p such that 4*p + 9 is also prime.

A023217.name: Primes p such that 5*p + 2 is also prime.

A023218.name: Primes p such that 5*p + 4 is also prime.

A023220.name: Primes p such that 5*p + 8 is also prime.

A023221.name: Primes p such that 6*p + 5 is also prime.

A023222.name: Primes p such that 6*p + 7 is also prime.

A023223.name: Primes p such that 7*p + 2 is also prime.

A023224.name: Primes p such that 7*p + 4 is also prime.

A023225.name: Primes p such that 7*p + 6 is also prime.

A023226.name: Primes p such that 7*p + 8 is also prime.

A023227.name: Primes p such that 7*p + 10 is also prime.

A023229.name: Primes p such that 8*p + 3 is also prime.

A023231.name: Primes p such that 8*p + 7 is also prime.

A023232.name: Primes p such that 8*p + 9 is also prime.

A023233.name: Primes p such that 9*p + 2 is also prime.

A023234.name: Primes p such that 9*p + 4 is also prime.

A023235.name: Primes p such that 9*p + 8 is also prime.

A023236.name: Primes p such that 9*p + 10 is also prime.

A023237.name: Primes p such that 10*p + 1 is also prime.

A023238.name: Primes p such that 10*p + 3 is also prime.

A023239.name: Primes p such that 10*p + 7 is also prime.

A023240.name: Primes p such that 10*p + 9 is also prime.

A023688.name: Numbers with exactly 6 ones in binary expansion.

A023689.name: Numbers with exactly 7 ones in binary expansion.

A023690.name: Numbers with exactly 8 ones in binary expansion.

A023691.name: Numbers with exactly 9 ones in binary expansion.

A023692.name: Numbers with a single 1 in their ternary expansion.

A023705.name: Numbers with no 0's in base-4 expansion.

A023709.name: Numbers with no 1's in their base 4 expansion.

A023713.name: Numbers with no 2's in their base 4 expansion.

A023717.name: Numbers with no 3's in base-4 expansion.

A023721.name: Numbers with no 0's in their base-5 expansion.

A023725.name: Numbers with no 1's in their base-5 expansion.

A023729.name: Numbers with no 2's in their base-5 expansion.

A023733.name: Numbers with no 3's in base-5 expansion.

A024619.name: Numbers that are not powers of primes p^k (k >= 0); complement of A000961.

A024675.name: Average of two consecutive odd primes.

A024892.name: Numbers k such that 3*k+1 is prime.

A024893.name: Numbers k such that 3*k+2 is prime.

A024894.name: Numbers k such that 5*k + 1 is prime.

A024895.name: Numbers k such that 5*k - 3 is prime.

A024896.name: Numbers k such that 5*k - 2 is prime.

A024902.name: Numbers k such that 7*k + 4 is prime.

A024903.name: Numbers k such that 7*k - 4 is prime.

A024904.name: Numbers k such that 7*k - 5 is prime.

A024905.name: Numbers k such that 7*k + 1 is prime.

A024906.name: Numbers k such that 9*k + 1 is prime.

A024907.name: Numbers k such that 9*k - 7 is prime.

A024908.name: Numbers k such that 9*k - 5 is prime.

A024909.name: Numbers k such that 9*k - 4 is prime.

A024910.name: Numbers k such that 9*k - 2 is prime.

A024912.name: Numbers k such that 10*k + 1 is prime.

A024913.name: Numbers k such that 10*k - 7 is prime.

A024914.name: Numbers k such that 10*k - 3 is prime.

A024916.name: a(n) = Sum_{k=1..n} k*floor(n/k); also Sum_{k=1..n} sigma(k) where sigma(n) = sum of divisors of n (A000203).

A026424.name: Number of prime divisors (counted with multiplicity) is odd; Liouville function lambda(n) (A008836) is negative.

A027697.name: Odious primes: primes with odd number of 1's in binary expansion.

A027699.name: Evil primes: primes with even number of 1's in their binary expansion.

A027752.name: Numbers k such that k^2 + k + 3 is prime.

A027754.name: Numbers k such that k^2 + k + 5 is prime.

A028823.name: Numbers k such that k^2 + k + 17 is prime.

A028983.name: Numbers whose sum of divisors is even.

A029739.name: Numbers that are congruent to {1, 3, 4} mod 6.

A030059.name: Numbers that are the product of an odd number of distinct primes.

A030124.name: Complement (and also first differences) of Hofstadter's sequence A005228.

A030141.name: Numbers in which parity of the decimal digits alternates.

A030229.name: Numbers that are the product of an even number of distinct primes.

A030628.name: 1 together with numbers of the form p*q^4 and p^9, where p and q are distinct primes.

A031177.name: Unhappy numbers: numbers having period-8 2-digitized sequences.

A031443.name: Digitally balanced numbers: positive numbers that in base 2 have the same number of 0's as 1's.

A031924.name: Primes followed by a gap of 6, i.e., next prime is p + 6.

A031926.name: Lower prime of a difference of 8 between consecutive primes.

A031930.name: Lower prime of a difference of 12 between consecutive primes.

A032796.name: Numbers that are congruent to {1, 2, 3, 5, 6} mod 7.

A032924.name: Numbers whose ternary expansion contains no 0.

A033200.name: Primes congruent to {1, 3} (mod 8); or, odd primes of form x^2 + 2*y^2.

A033568.name: Second pentagonal numbers with odd index: a(n) = (2*n-1)*(3*n-1).

A033868.name: Numbers n such that 7*n-11 is prime.

A033992.name: Numbers that are divisible by exactly three different primes.

A033993.name: Numbers that are divisible by exactly four different primes.

A034709.name: Numbers divisible by their last digit.

A034936.name: Numbers k such that 3*k + 4 is prime.

A036554.name: Numbers whose binary representation ends in an odd number of zeros.

A036668.name: Hati numbers: of form 2^i*3^j*k, i+j even, (k,6)=1.

A036689.name: Product of a prime and the previous number.

A036690.name: Product of a prime and the following number.

A036785.name: Numbers divisible by the squares of two distinct primes.

A037030.name: Numbers n such that 666*n + 1 is prime.

A037123.name: a(n) = a(n-1) + sum of digits of n.

A038580.name: Primes with indices that are primes with prime indices.

A038770.name: Numbers divisible by at least one of their digits.

A038873.name: Primes p such that 2 is a square mod p; or, primes congruent to {1, 2, 7} mod 8.

A040117.name: Primes congruent to 5 (mod 12). Also primes p such that x^4 = 9 has no solution mod p.

A045546.name: Numbers k such that k^2 + k - 1 is prime.

A045572.name: Numbers that are odd but not divisible by 5.

A045920.name: Numbers m such that the factorizations of m..m+1 have the same number of primes (including multiplicities).

A045954.name: Even-Lucky-Numbers: generated by a sieve process like that for Lucky numbers but starting with even numbers.

A046099.name: Numbers that are not cubefree. Numbers divisible by a cube greater than 1. Complement of A004709.

A046100.name: Biquadratefree numbers: numbers that are not divisible by any 4th power greater than 1.

A046133.name: Primes p such that p + 12 is also prime.

A046306.name: Numbers that are divisible by exactly 6 primes with multiplicity.

A046308.name: Numbers that are divisible by exactly 7 primes counting multiplicity.

A046310.name: Numbers that are divisible by exactly 8 primes counting multiplicity.

A046315.name: Odd semiprimes: odd numbers divisible by exactly 2 primes (counted with multiplicity).

A046386.name: Products of exactly four distinct primes.

A046388.name: Odd numbers of the form p*q where p and q are distinct primes.
